note: Territories of the Holy Roman Empire in the 16th century: Ramona Roller, 'Spatio-temporal data on territories of the Holy Roman Empire', ETH Zurich Research Collection, 2021 (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0). Borders traced by the author from the maps in Schindling & Ziegler, 'Die Territorien des Reichs im Zeitalter der Reformation und Konfessionalisierung' (1989-97); confessions and dates looked up on Wikipedia by the author. Research data of uneven quality: coverage is incomplete (no Habsburg hereditary lands, Bohemia or imperial knights), and dates come from Wikipedia. One feature per territory and confession period; Orbis grouped 'calvinist' with 'reformed' and simplified the borders.
